title: freeforge-handoff
description: Runtime-neutral task-handoff/evidence record for freeforge-chat. Produced and consumed only by tools/control-plane/handoff.mjs. See docs/control-plane/handoff-contract.md for the semantics this schema alone cannot express (evidence-state rules, promotion, staleness).

objective.description: What this task is trying to accomplish, in the handoff author's own words.

baselineSha.description: The Git commit this handoff's claims (changedFiles, verification) were evaluated against. A consumer must compare this to the current HEAD before trusting anything below it — see docs/control-plane/handoff-contract.md#staleness.

path.description: Optional worktree path. Machine-specific; omit rather than hardcode a path that will not resolve on another machine or CI.

intendedScope.description: The boundary of what this task is authorized to touch, stated explicitly so scope creep is detectable.

changedFiles.description: Repository-relative paths actually changed as of baselineSha. Not a promise about files that will be changed next.

nonGoals.description: Explicit non-goals: what this task deliberately does not attempt, so a reader does not mistake absence of coverage for an oversight.

productionImpact.description: Whether any change recorded here touches or is reachable from production (see MIGRATION_CONTRACT.md 3.8 — a merge to main is production publication for this repository).

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write to this record, set only by tools/control-plane/handoff.mjs.

id.description: Stable identifier for this check, e.g. "npm-test" or "biome-check".

command.description: The exact command that was (or would be) executed. Required and non-empty when state is PASSED or FAILED, since both of those states claim the command actually ran.

result.description: Captured outcome (exit code, summary, or short excerpt) of an executed command. Required and non-empty when state is PASSED.

rationale.description: Required and non-empty when state is NOT_APPLICABLE: why this check does not apply to this task.

state.description: See docs/control-plane/handoff-contract.md#evidence-semantics. There is no default; every entry must state its own evidence state explicitly.
